axes.fidelity: 0 ignores brief; 1 major omissions; 2 partial; 3 all requirements with minor defects; 4 exact brief and working defining mechanisms supported by host observations
axes.content: 0 invented or empty; 1 generic; 2 partly specific; 3 concrete accurate complete; 4 specific, coherent and economical
axes.finish: 0 broken/unusable; 1 substantial defects; 2 rough; 3 polished with minor defects; 4 clear finished result with no meaningful defect

scoring: Arithmetic mean of the three independently evidenced 0..4 axes. No rounding or noise allowance. Native/tool execution cannot be inferred from prose. For visual artifacts, the judge must see actual Obscura candidate images and the driver report. Unsupported cases are null and block admission.
comparison: Blinded paired first drafts from the same immutable brief and fixtures; no targeted repair output reused as a fresh first draft. Source task must improve strictly; every frozen suite case must be at least its baseline score.
